title: K Manga Adds Daiki Yamazaki's Golden Phantom Manga
content:
The company describes the series:

While on an outing to an amusement park with his family to celebrate his daughter's middle school graduation, Shingo Asahina encounters a mysterious man covered in blood being pursued by some unsavory characters. On the spur of the moment, he gets on the Ferris wheel with the wounded man to shelter him. When questioned, the man simply says “In 30 minutes, this amusement park will turn into hell on Earth,” and explains that in order to prevent disaster, he needs to “borrow” Shingo's body…

Yamazaki ( Chaos Game ) debuted the manga in Kodansha 's Afternoon magazine on February 25. The first compiled book volume shipped in Japan on July 22.

Yamazaki launched the Chaos Game manga in Kodansha 's Afternoon magazine in July 2022, and ended it in June 2024. Kodansha published the manga's fifth and final compiled book volume in September 2024. Kodansha 's K MANGA service published Chaos Game in English.

Yamazaki published the "Kishibe no Yume" one-shot manga in Kodansha 's Moae magazine in 2022.

title: Netflix Confirms Release Date for New Horror Anime From Legendary Studios & Fans Aren’t Happy
content:
Netflix has confirmed the release date and schedule for a new horror thriller anime hitting later this year, but unfortunately fans are not happy with the streaming service right now. Netflix took the stage during the Anime NYC 2026 weekend to give fans a major update about all of the new projects they now have in the works, and that includes some big licenses that fans have been wanting to see. But unfortunately for some of these highly anticipated releases, the Netflix binge release model won’t exactly be a great fit.

Kasumi Yasuda’s Fool Night is gearing up to make its official anime adaptation debut with Netflix later this November, and has dropped a full new look showing off what to expect from its highly anticipated premiere. But unfortunately it has also confirmed that all of its episodes will be releasing at once rather than dropping weekly. And fans are not happy that the series’ mystery won’t get a chance to flesh out in the way they were hoping for. Check out the new trailer and special interview video for Fool Night below.

When Does Fool Night Come Out on Netflix?

Fool Night will be making its worldwide debut with Netflix on November 26th, and will be releasing all of its episodes at once. It’s going to be a joint production between two legendary anime studios with Atsuyuki Yukawa directing the anime for Sunrise ( Mobile Suit Gundam ) and Shaft ( Puella Magi Madoka Magica ), Jin Tanaka handling the series composition, Robert Sato providing the character designs, and Tatsuya Kato composing the music. So it’s going to both look and sound great.

The main voice cast of Fool Night has been confirmed as well with Koki Uchiyama as Toshiro Kamiya, Minako Kotobuki as Yomiko Horai, Junya Enoki as Akira Yatsuka, Aya Endo as Saeko Kanaeno, and Kiyomitsu Mizuuchi as Jin Hiragishi. Netflix has confirmed that the series will also be launching with an English dub, and it will be led by Adam McArthur as Toshiro and Olivia Liang as Yomiko. Thankfully it won’t be too much longer before fans get to see this new series in action.

What Is Fool Night?

Kasumi Yasuda’s Fool Night manga has been a standout with Shogakukan’s Big Comic Superior magazine ever since it made its debut back in 2020, and it’s no mystery as to why as the franchise sparks a cool new mystery in a dark world. With oxygen running out, humanity has resorted to planting flowers and other plants within dying people in a process known as “Transfloration” that keeps that minimal oxygen supply going for as long as it can. But it seems like it’s all going to hit right at once.

Netflix’s release strategy has been changing quite a lot with its anime premieres in the last few years, and it’s meant that a lot of the newer hits have been able to drop their new episodes on a weekly basis much like their initial debuts in Japan. This is a far cry from the binge releases that used to come months after the fact that the streaming service used to do, but when it occasionally happens it still comes as a bummer for those fans hoping to see the series getting to flesh out over several weeks and spark discussion that way. It’s still possible, but fans are going to need to work that much harder.

title: Crunchyroll Adds English Dubs for One Piece TV Anime's Elbaph Arc on October 20, One Piece: Heroines on October 13
content:
The One Piece Heroines anime premiered on July 5 on Fuji TV with episode: NAMI. Crunchyroll is streaming the anime.

The One Piece anime's Elbaph arc debuted in Japan on April 5. Crunchyroll is streaming the arc.

Singer Aina The End performs the opening theme song "Luminous," and rock band 36km/h perform the ending theme song "Sono Mirai" (That Future).

Toei Animation and One Piece anime producer Ryūta Koike announced in October 2025 that the anime is reducing its annual episode output to a maximum of 26 episodes moving forward starting in 2026. Following the conclusion of the Egghead arc last year, the anime took a three-month production hiatus from January-March 2026. The anime returned in April 2026 for the first of two cours (quarters of a year) with the start of the new Elbaph arc.

title: The Apothecary Diaries Movie Confirms First Release Date Ahead of 2026 Debut – Watch Trailer
content:
The Apothecary Diaries is hitting the big screen with its first big movie, and it’s now set an official release date for its first launch later this year. The anime adaptation for Hyuganatsu’s original light novel series has been a monster hit ever since it made its debut, and has already released two seasons under its belt. But it’s planning an even bigger comeback for the franchise’s future with both a third season of the TV anime and a feature film release hitting later this year . It’s a lot to look forward to.

The Apothecary Diaries is hitting theaters across Japan this December with a brand new movie that will feature a completely original story from the creator behind it all . A new teaser has been revealed for the upcoming project, and further confirms a December 11th release date for its first launch in Japan. While fans outside of Japan will have to wait a big longer to see the new movie in action for themselves, you can check out a new teaser for the release below.

What to Know for The Apothecary Diaries Movie

The Apothecary Diaries: The Deceased Empress’ Treasure (which has yet to confirm its official English licensed title as of this time) will be making its debut across theaters in Japan on December 11th , but unfortunately no international release plans have been announced for the film yet. It’s highly likely given the popularity of the TV anime series, and we’ve seen a lot of projects make their way to international theaters in recent years shortly after their Japanese launch.

The Apothecary Diaries: The Deceased Empress’ Treasure will feature a returning production staff from the TV anime series, and will be telling an original story not seen in the anime, manga, or light novel releases before. Aoi Yuki as Maomao and Takeo Otsuka as Jinshi will be leading the returning cast from the TV anime series, and an important new addition has been revealed with Mariya Ise joining the project as Mu Qing. But while fans outside of Japan wait for an international release , we’ll see more updates revealed soon enough.

What’s Next for The Apothecary Diaries in 2026?

But although fans outside of Japan won’t get their chance to see the new feature film in action just yet, there is still going to be plenty to enjoy from The Apothecary Diaries through the rest of the year. The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 will be kicking off its first cour of episodes on October 2nd , and will be streaming exclusively with Crunchyroll as part of their jam packed schedule for the Fall 2026 anime season. The series will then return for a second cour of the season sometime in April 2027 as part of the Spring 2027 anime schedule.

So much like the first two seasons of the series, The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 is also going to be a full two cour slate before it’s all said and done. This time around fans just get a new movie release in between these episodes too. With both the third season and movie teasing some big events and mysteries that Maomao will need to get to the bottom of, it’s going to be exciting. Make sure to catch up with it all streaming with Crunchyroll in the meantime.

title: One Piece’s English Dub Confirms Crunchyroll Release Date for Elbaph Arc & More
content:
One Piece: Elbaph Arc is nearing the end of its run this Summer, and thankfully Crunchyroll has finally set a release date for its English dub return with a newly confirmed release schedule. One Piece has been working its way through a whole new era of the anime this year as with its return earlier this Spring , the TV series kicked off a new release schedule with 26 episodes planned per year from now on. And it’s been a great way to help usher in the long waited Elbaph Arc.

One Piece: Elbaph Arc has been working its way through its Japanese language release since earlier this Spring, and Crunchyroll has now confirmed that the anime will be kicking off its English, Spanish, and Portuguese dub release beginning later this October. Beginning with Episode 1156 of the series, and even including the recently released One Piece: Heroines anime special in between , the English dub is going to enact a new release schedule moving forward too.

One Piece: Elbaph Arc Confirms English Dub Release Schedule With Crunchyroll

The new One Piece English dub schedule will begin first with the release of One Piece Heroines with Crunchyroll on October 13th at 9AM PT. It will then continue with the start of One Piece: Elbaph Arc with the English dub premiere of Episode 1156 on October 20th at 9AM PT. But while previous English dub releases of the franchise saw the dub release in batches of episodes, that release schedule is going to change with the upcoming premiere of the Elbaph Arc. And that’s likely going to be the same moving forward.

Episodes of One Piece’ s English dub will be releasing with Crunchyroll on a weekly basis, and will be streaming with the service on Tuesdays at 9AM PT for fans in the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, South Africa, India, Southeast Asia, and Latin America. This is a big change from the way the dub had been released in the past, but that’s also because One Piece itself has made a major change to its own production schedule this year and every other year to come moving forward.

What Does This Mean for One Piece’s Dub Future?

As One Piece is now adamant to produce 26 episodes year from now on, that production schedule is going to be impacting its other release schedules moving forward to. One Piece: Elbaph Arc will be ending its Japanese language release in just a couple of more months with only six or so episodes left to go as of the time of this writing, so it just remains to be seen what that means for the future of the series heading into 2027 and beyond.

One Piece: Elbaph Arc will be returning for 26 more episodes sometime in 2027, but that’s far from all. It’s been announced that One Piece will be releasing two new feature films in the near future beginning with One Piece Film God Valley in 2027 and One Piece Film BAAD in 2029 . A remake series is also set to kick off with Netflix in February 2027, and a third season of the live-action series hits Netflix next year too. It’s a lot to look forward to.

title: Rock Band SCANDAL Announces Disbandment After 21 Years
content:
The official website of SCANDAL announced on Monday that the four-member all-female rock band will disband on August 21, 2027, following their final concert at the Yokohama Arena in Kanagawa Prefecture. The disbandment date will coincide with the band's 21st anniversary.

The band explained that after reaching their 20th anniversary, they held numerous discussions and felt they had fully accomplished everything they could do together as a four-member group. To conclude their journey, SCANDAL will embark on a final tour across all 47 Japanese prefectures starting October 22.

SCANDAL originally formed in August 2006 as high school students from a vocal and dance school in Osaka, performing indie gigs at Osaka Castle Park. The current lineup consists of vocalist and guitarist Ono Haruna, guitarist and vocalist Sasazaki Mami, bassist and vocalist Ogawa Tomomi, and drummer and vocalist Suzuki Rina. They made their major debut in October 2008 with the single "DOLL" under Epic Records Japan and won the New Artist Award at the Japan Record Awards in December 2009. In December 2018, the band established their private label, "her." In August 2023, SCANDAL was officially recognized by the Guinness World Records as the longest-running rock band with the same female members.

The band has been widely acclaimed for their contributions to anime music, with theme songs for Bleach , Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood , Star Driver: Kagayaki no Takuto , Loups=Garous , and Pokemon Movie 17: Hakai no Mayu to Diancie .

title: Crunchyroll Confirms U.S. Release Date for Major 2026 Anime Movie With New Look
content:
A major movie released in Japan earlier this year, and now Crunchyroll and Sony Pictures Entertainment have confirmed that they will soon be bringing it to the United States with an official theatrical release. The last few years have been great for anime projects in theaters, and many of them have found a lot of worldwide success thanks to a few breakthroughs that really made an impact with fans. It’s made the prospect of bringing even more anime releases to theaters soon after their initial release even more promising.

That’s the case with The Irregular at Magic High School . The anime franchise has had a lot of success with its multiple TV seasons , spinoff, and even a previous feature film release. It made its return to theaters earlier this year in Japan with a brand new film for the Yotsuba Succession Arc, and now it’s been confirmed that Crunchyroll and Sony Pictures Entertainment are going to be bringing this new movie to the United States and Canada for a limited time this November.

New The Irregular at Magic High School Movie Gets 2026 U.S. Release Date

The Irregular at Magic High School THE MOVIE -Yotsuba Succession Arc- is going to be making its debut in theaters in the United States and Canada for a very limited time with screenings on November 1st, 3rd and 4th. It’s going to be screening with both a Japanese language and English dubbed audio available. This new movie picks up right after the events of the TV anime’s third season , so you’re going to want to catch up with everything that’s happened in the anime so far now streaming with Crunchyroll in the meantime.

The Irregular at Magic High School THE MOVIE -Yotsuba Succession Arc- is directed by Jimmy Stone, and adapts the titular Yotsuba Succession Arc that takes place in Volume 16 of Tsutomu Sato’s original light novels. It’s brought to life by the same studio behind the rest of the anime franchise, Eight Bit, so it’s all going to look just as good as it did in the original TV anime. It’s also the first in a whole new wave of anime releases planned for the franchise’s near future.

What’s Next for The Irregular at Magic High School?

The Irregular at Magic High School THE MOVIE -Yotsuba Succession Arc- is funny enough, the capstone to just the first part of the long running anime franchise thus far. There’s even more on the way in the future as “Part 2” is now confirmed to be in the works. More details for the anime’s future is set to be revealed at a later date, but this second phase of the anime is likely going to continue to work through the multiple volumes of the light novels still yet to make it to screens.

The Irregular at Magic High School is certainly one of the more interesting success stories of the 2010s as while it took quite a few years before the second season actually made its debut, the franchise quickly released all sorts of projects that expanded it in many other ways like spinoffs, movies and more. It’s not slowing down anytime soon, so make sure you’re caught up with it all before November.

It’s going to be screening with both a Japanese language and English dubbed audio available. This new movie picks up right after the events of the TV anime’s third season , so you’re going to want to catch up with everything that’s happened in the anime so far now streaming with Crunchyroll in the meantime.

The Irregular at Magic High School THE MOVIE -Yotsuba Succession Arc- is directed by Jimmy Stone, and adapts the titular Yotsuba Succession Arc that takes place in Volume 16 of Tsutomu Sato’s original light novels. It’s brought to life by the same studio behind the rest of the anime franchise, Eight Bit, so it’s all going to look just as good as it did in the original TV anime. It’s also the first in a whole new wave of anime releases planned for the franchise’s near future.
What’s Next for The Irregular at Magic High School?

The Irregular at Magic High School THE MOVIE -Yotsuba Succession Arc- is funny enough, the capstone to just the first part of the long running anime franchise thus far. There’s even more on the way in the future as “Part 2” is now confirmed to be in the works. More details for the anime’s future is set to be revealed at a later date, but this second phase of the anime is likely going to continue to work through the multiple volumes of the light novels still yet to make it to screens.

The Irregular at Magic High School is certainly one of the more interesting success stories of the 2010s as while it took quite a few years before the second season actually made its debut, the franchise quickly released all sorts of projects that expanded it in many other ways like spinoffs, movies and more. It’s not slowing down anytime soon, so make sure you’re caught up with it all before November.
